source.sourceScope: Ignored clean diagnostic commit with the stated production parent and observer-only overlay; the main production checkout was not changed by this run.

sse.detailedSummaryPopulation: 1000 measured SSE requests only; 100 warmups excluded. JSON retains complete-response metrics and stage counts, without extending these partitions to JSON.

native.backgroundScope: Stage intervals on traces without a captured request envelope, including startup or background work; nested stages overlap and are not caller or batch cardinality.

sse.detailedSummaryPopulation: 1000 measured SSE requests only; 100 warmups excluded. JSON retains complete-response metrics and stage counts, without extending these partitions to JSON.

jit.backgroundScope: Stage intervals on traces without a captured request envelope, including startup or background work; nested stages overlap and are not caller or batch cardinality.

observationPolicy.stageScope: Inclusive method wall intervals include client handling, parsing, scheduling, failure policy and uncaptured code. Neither these intervals nor the disjoint remainder is CPU, scheduler-wait or Redis-server time. Nested stages and marginal percentile summaries must not be added or subtracted to infer causes.
observationPolicy.partitionScope: Only 1000 measured SSE requests per role are partitioned, in each request server stopwatch coordinates. Priority unions of four I/O methods, remaining security wall, normalization, other SQL and the complement are disjoint and sum to usage entry through second authentication start. This interval also includes middleware, body/argument binding, activation, validation and logging; it is not binding-only.
observationPolicy.backgroundScope: Background intervals are retained separately and can overlap one another. They do not map one-to-one to waiting callers.
observationPolicy.runtimeSamplerScope: Whole-process numeric observations every 100 ms; ticks may coalesce. Zero observed queue does not establish absence of queue wait.
observationPolicy.comparisonScope: One fixed-order instrumented pair, 100 excluded warmups plus 1000 measured complete responses per workload. No efficacy, significance, historical recovery or causal attribution claim.

archivedLedgerAudit.reviewScope: Independent retained read-only archive calculation; no database restore, live queries or new requests.

sourcePreparationNote: A fresh ignored clean clone carries the nine-file phase overlay plus eight literal stages over the stated parent. Source preparation corrected a path-comparison precondition before application. Earlier failed preparation and review evidence remains retained; no failed gate is reclassified as a completed diagnostic.

posthocAnalysisCorrections.scope: After the pipeline closed, the first analyzer attempt failed its client-mode assertion before writing output. V3 corrected the client enum to streaming. V4 corrected only the server label accessor to requestMode; every timing, count, row, partition and raw binding is identical to retained V3. Each request retains both authentication spans, including the first span’s early unknown mode, and joins them by TraceId. Earlier sources, failure evidence and output remain preserved; no raw capture or workload was changed.

conclusion: All eight measured-SSE stage summaries and the JSON/background observation counts are retained. These wall-time observations guide further investigation; they do not demonstrate that the regression is resolved or identify its cause.
